Change c0197. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. I; 1831 Ch. IX.

Context before (unchanged): I, not in deed, but in effect, was the true murderer.

1818 text: Elizabeth read my anguish in my countenance, and kindly taking my hand said, "My dearest cousin, you must calm yourself.

1831 text: Elizabeth read my anguish in my countenance, and kindly taking my hand, said, "My dearest friend, you must calm yourself.

Diff: Elizabeth read my anguish in my countenance, and kindly taking my hand {+,+} said, " My dearest [-cousin-] {+friend+} , you must calm yourself.

Context after (unchanged): These events have affected me, God knows how deeply; but I am not so wretched as you are.

result.rationale: Elizabeth's address changes from "my dearest cousin" to "my dearest friend" (plus a comma), altering her stated relationship to Victor; the kinship is removed, making her a friend rather than a cousin, which bears on the family bond central to the novel.
